parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all internal and external components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses the internal washing system, and ensures durability and stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is a stainless steel panel that seals the washing compartment during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior for loading and unloading dishes and seals tightly to prevent water leakage during washing cycles.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates downward on hinges to open and closes upward to lock in place.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and contains buttons or a touch interface for user input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to select washing modes, start or stop cycles, and adjust settings.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons or touch interface may have small actuation movements when pressed or touched.
